hero.title: Our Story:
hero.description: Born from the frustration of educators who knew they could do more, Tutori was created to give teachers the superpower they deserve.

story.title: Why I Created Tutori
story.paragraph1: I've been teaching English for six years, and I really love what I do. I love my students, and I always try my best to help them.
story.paragraph2: But when I was teaching in classrooms, there was always the same problem—some students were left behind. Not because they didn't care or weren't smart, but because they just didn't understand the lesson right away. And I couldn't help everyone the way I wanted to.
story.paragraph3: There were only six hours in the day, and too many students who needed something different. Some needed more time, others needed things explained in another way. But the class had to move forward, even if not everyone was ready.
story.paragraph4: I became a teacher to help students learn and grow. But it's so difficult when you don't have the time to give each student what they really need.
story.paragraph6: A few years later, I realized we could build a tool where every student has their own personal AI tutor—one that understands the teacher's lesson plan, gets to know the student, and explains the lesson in the way that student learns best.
story.paragraph7: Now no student has to be left behind.

quote.text: "I don't want AI to teach my students. I want AI to help me teach my students better."
